notes.title: Split Square 8-21 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Changes

-Some UI sprite changes

-Sizing some UI on PC

-Keywords below have been replaced.
Can't-overlap -> Exhaust : If you use the skill, it will consumed immediately even if the usable count remains.

-Beginner's Headband: Attacks of Skills with a base cost of 3 or less +8 -> 6

-Fingernails of Reincarnation : Debuff Adjustment

-The effect of the curse block changes as follows.
Curse Blocks : If a break curse block is broken, that block gives random condition state with a 25% chance.

-Area
The existing range does not disappear even if the range overlaps.
The area skill is now also affected by the increase in the number of block installations.


Fixed bug

-A bug that didn't show a shortcut to check the battle information window on PC

notes.title: Split Square 8-12 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Changes

- Remove the health penalty for deck recovery

Boss battle's health and gold rewards increased significantly

hard battle's health and gold rewards increased

The effect of 'BloodSucking' changes as follows.

-> Whenever you hit the enemy, you get N health.

The figures for all related items have been adjusted.

-Increased health of bomb blocks (30 -> 60), Reduced damage (10 -> 5)

-If a knockback block knocks a player back, it damages itself. 
A knockback block is knocked back only up to three times.

-The effects of the Divine Block, Curse Block will be changed as follows.

Divinity Blocks : Battle Rewards increase by the number of remaining Divinity Blocks.
Curse Block : Breaking a curse block gives you 10 health, or 10 damage with a 50% chance.

-A projectile speed reduction penalty is added to the penalty that gives explosion, induction to the enemy's projectile.

notes.title: Split Square 2-23 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Changes

-Added animations for triggering special effects such as Impact or bloodsucking.

-Standardized some attack direction descriptions to use 'N direction'.

-Enhanced sprites of certain items.

-Eliminated common skill keywords and introduced a single attack keyword instead.

-Remade effect of Roulette Spin, Draw Sword, and Energy Absorbing Harpoon.

-Buffed attack directions and attack times of Emergency Barrage, Diagonal Shot, and Wide-spread Assault skills.

-Downgraded grades of Detection Hand Blade and Lightning Hand Blade from 3 to 1.

-Transformed items like Glass Window, Photocopier, Graduation Cap, General-Purpose Rechargeable Battery, etc., into single-attack synergy effects.


Fixed Bugs

-Fixed a bug causing the game to crash when entering ruins in specific languages.

-Corrected a bug where the remote control effects of area-installing skills would be disabled upon repeated activation.

Player's Installation follow player.

00 attacks get XX. Elemental attack power also applies to 00 skills.
